plugins.name: turn-stats
plugins.description: Per-turn usage stats under the last message: tok/s, input/output tokens, cache hit %, total and duration

plugins.name: async-compaction
plugins.description: Asynchronous (background) compaction: a cheap model summarizes the conversation ahead of time, and at the compaction limit the summary is swapped in with the latest messages kept raw

plugins.name: loop-breaker
plugins.description: Notices when Claude repeats the same failing tool call and tells it to stop retrying and change approach

plugins.name: context-gauge
plugins.description: The context's fill against Claude Code's auto-compact limit on the status line, and a short note to Claude when it passes 50, 75 and 90%

plugins.name: edit-check
plugins.description: After Claude edits files, runs the project's own check command in the background and hands Claude the new errors at its next request

plugins.name: test-gate
plugins.description: When Claude ends a turn after editing code without running a test or check, claude-haiku-5-5 decides whether it should, and if so the turn goes on once with a note asking Claude to run the tests or say why not

plugins.name: output-shaper
plugins.description: When a Bash command prints a lot, Claude reads its first and last lines, the line and character counts, and the path of the whole output with a hint to Grep or Read it

plugins.name: handoff
plugins.description: Keeps a short handoff note per repository (the work, what was done, what is next, open problems), written by claude-haiku-5-5 after turns that do real work, and hands it to Claude at session start and after each compaction
